And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher. en.53: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
en.54: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
en.55: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
en.56: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
en.57: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.
en.58: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
en.59: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
